title: Familien-Steuerzentrale
subtitle: Realized gains, household wash-sale checks, per-member contribution limits, tax-loss harvesting, and year-end readiness.
disclaimer: Informational estimates only — not tax advice. Realized gains follow each account's configured cost-basis method; wash-sale alerts are advisory, do not modify persisted lot basis, and only detect matching asset IDs (not different-ticker substantially identical securities). Verify all figures against official broker tax forms (1099-B, 1099-DIV, 1099-INT) and consult a qualified tax professional.
